notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to amass Orcs 2.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.
